answer.thought: The body is a vessel of needs that has been neglected, and the spirit cannot rise while the stomach roars. The sun is already gone, and the park will close soon; there is no point in lingering in the dark for the sake of a view that offers no illumination. I must return to the bungalow to seek sustenance, or at least to collapse into the silence of a room that is my own.
